lead_raw_text:
The structure of VFeAs crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms—V4 Fe4 As4—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Fe centers with 10 geometric neighbors (2 As, 6 Fe, 2 V), V centers with 12 neighbors (6 As, 6 Fe), and As centers with 9 neighbors (6 Fe, 3 V), all forming a single 3-periodic connectivity component. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and face-sharing between As and V polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Fe and V polyhedra.
